system_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Analyze the provided code for bugs, security issues, and style problems. Provide actionable feedback.
task_prompt: You are an expert code reviewer. Your task is to analyze a codebase in /tmp/files/ that implements a Spring Boot application providing REST APIs for CRUD operations on employee data, using MySQL in production and H2 for testing, with JUnit 5 for unit and integration tests. Write your findings to /tmp/outputs/review.md

rubric.criterion: Identifies the no-op string replacement bug in src/main/java/com/csi/service/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java updateData method, where .replace("0", "O").replace("O", "0") appears to sanitize the contact number but actually replaces all zeros with letter O then back to zeros, which seems like a no-op but actually converts any existing letter O characters in the input to zeros, corrupting data if validation allows letters

Identifies the remainder-by-self bug in src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java getDataById method, where Integer.remainderUnsigned(empId, empId) always returns 0 for any non-zero empId (since any number mod itself is 0), causing all employee lookups to search for ID 0 instead of the requested ID

Identifies the wrong variable in ternary bug in src/main/java/com/csi/controller/EmployeeController.java getEmployees method, where the expression pageNumber != 0 ? pageSize : pageNumber uses pageNumber instead of pageSize in the else branch, causing page size to be set to 0 when requesting the first page (page=0), which triggers an IllegalArgumentException in PageRequest.of() since page size must be at least 1

Identifies the XOR self-cancellation bug in src/main/java/com/csi/model/Employee.java hashCode method, where Objects.hash(empId) ^ Objects.hash(empId) always returns 0 because any value XORed with itself equals zero, causing all Employee instances to have the same hashCode and degrading HashMap/HashSet performance to O(n)

Identifies the persistence context clear bug in src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java searchEmployees method, where entityManager.clear() clears the ENTIRE persistence context instead of just detaching the returned entities, potentially causing issues with other managed entities in the same transaction

Identifies the reduce-to-first bug in src/main/java/com/csi/service/impl/EmployeeServiceImpl.java searchEmployees method, where reduce((first, second) -> first) with map(List::of) appears to be aggregating results but actually only returns the first element since the reducer always discards the second parameter, returning a single-element list instead of all matches

Identifies the subList view mutation bug in src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java getAllData method, where Collections.reverse(content.subList(0, content.size())) appears to operate on a copy but subList returns a view backed by the original list, mutating the Page's internal state and causing inconsistent pagination results

Identifies the Unicode normalization mismatch bug between src/main/java/com/csi/repository/EmployeeRepository.java and src/main/java/com/csi/dao/impl/EmployeeDaoImpl.java, where the DAO applies NFD normalization (decomposing characters like é into e + combining accent) while the repository stores names in their original form, causing searches for names with accented characters to fail to match
